
{{alias}}( value )
    Returns the penalty string associated with a supported SGD
    classification penalty value.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: any
        Penalty value.

    Returns
    -------
    out: string|null
        Penalty string.

    Examples
    --------
    > var out = {{alias}}( 'l1' )
    'l1'
    > var v = {{alias:@stdlib/ml/base/sgd-classification/penalty-str2enum}}( 'l1' );
    > out = {{alias}}( v )
    'l1'

    --------
